summary: Polygon's Tasha Robinson surveys Warner Bros.' planned DC film and TV slate as the DCEU winds down and James Gunn and Peter Safran take over DC Studios to build a new mainline "DCU". It lists dated releases from Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom (2023) through The Batman Part II (2025), plus many undated projects such as The Penguin, Creature Commandos, Waller, and Lanterns. It also covers Sandman season 2, Dead Boy Detectives, and Peacemaker season 2.
one_line: Overview of Warner Bros.' upcoming DC movies and TV shows as the DCEU ends and Gunn and Safran launch the new DCU.
key_facts: The DC Extended Universe launched with Zack Snyder's Man of Steel in 2013 and has repeatedly switched strategies while trying to compete with the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
In 2023 the Snyderverse winds down with Shazam! Fury of the Gods, The Flash, and Blue Beetle, leading to the finale Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom.
James Gunn and producer Peter Safran are taking over the newly branded DC Studios and replacing the DCEU with a mainline continuity called "the DCU".
Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom is dated Dec. 20, 2023, with James Wan directing and Jason Momoa, Nicole Kidman, Ben Affleck, Patrick Wilson, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II, and Amber Heard returning.
Joker: Folie à Deux is dated Oct. 4, 2024; it is reportedly a musical thriller with Joaquin Phoenix returning and Lady Gaga as Harley Quinn, and the first Joker was a billion-dollar hit.
Creature Commandos is a seven-episode adult animated series written by James Gunn, with David Harbour voicing Eric Frankenstein and Amanda Waller creating a black ops team of monstrous prisoners.
Waller is a Peacemaker spinoff starring Viola Davis as Amanda Waller, and Gunn has put Peacemaker season 2 on hold to focus on it and other projects.
Superman: Legacy is dated July 11, 2025, with Gunn scripting it; Henry Cavill is moving on from the Superman role.
The Batman Part II is dated Oct. 3, 2025, with Matt Reeves directing and Robert Pattinson returning as Batman after the first film was a box-office success.

HBO Max's The Penguin is an eight-episode series with Colin Farrell, overseen by Lauren LeFranc, bridging The Batman and its sequel; a second spinoff set in Arkham Asylum is led by showrunner Antonio Campos after Terence Winter left.
Brave and the Bold will introduce Batman's biological son Damian to the DCU, inspired by Grant Morrison's Batman and Son, and will be separate from Reeves' Batman trilogy.
Netflix announced in November 2022 that Sandman was greenlit for a second season, likely to adapt book four, Season of Mists.
Dead Boy Detectives was sold by Max to Netflix in February 2023 because it doesn't fit Gunn's plans; the first season has eight episodes.
Gunn says Peacemaker season 2 with Christopher Smith will come after he wraps production on Superman: Legacy, probably in 2025 or later.
